summary: Iteration 9 — P0 economy fix (credit / anti-stacking) verified. Created /app/backend/tests/test_credit_system.py covering all 8 acceptance criteria: shape of /api/bank, anti-stacking invariant (credit_limit unchanged after borrowing full credit_available; second loan rejected 400 with 'borrow up to $0 more (total limit $X, already used $X)'), over-limit + zero/negative rejection, repay clamps to debt + restores credit_available to credit_limit + resets credit_missed to 0 on full payoff + 400 'You have no debt to repay', criminal-record denial (legal_reputation<25 → blocked=true, reasons include 'serious criminal record', POST /api/bank/loan 403 'Credit denied: ...'), reduced limit for legal_reputation<40 (criminal record reason, lower than baseline), limit composition (mara/kiri/dovan all positive, factors block present), missed-payment effect (credit_missed=5 lowers limit and reasons include 'missed payment(s)'), loan side effects (player.bank += amt, player.debt += amt, finance event in /api/game/events, 'Loan approved' notification, 'Debt repaid' notification on repay), and deposit/withdraw invariance (credit_limit unchanged → confirms net-worth-based limit can't be inflated by moving cash<->bank). 14/14 PASS. Re-ran prior Phase C regression (test_phase_c_employment.py 18 + test_phase_c_fixes.py 13 + test_phase_c_hours_promotion.py 6 = 37 tests) — all PASS. Full suite 51/51 PASS. Frontend /bank for mara@kaeldor.com verified end-to-end via Playwright: credit-summary box renders with credit-limit=$4,031 / credit-used=$0 / credit-available=$4,031, 'You can borrow up to $4,031 more...' sentence present, AVAILABLE CREDIT StatTile shows $4,031, loan-preview shows live with loan-new-debt updating, entering 9,999,999 shows red loan-over-limit text ('Exceeds available credit ($4,031). Repay debt or improve creditworthiness first.') and disables the Borrow button (loan-button), borrowing $50 updates summary to used=$50/avail=$3,981, full repay restores used=$0/avail=$4,031. All required data-testids resolve: credit-summary, credit-limit, credit-used, credit-available, loan-preview, loan-new-debt, loan-over-limit, loan-button, repay-button, loan-input, repay-input, deposit-button, withdraw-button.
critical_code_review_comments: credit_profile (server.py L282-341): correctly uses compute_net_worth (cash+bank-debt+assets) which is INVARIANT under a loan because bank and debt move together by the same amount. This is the right structural fix — the limit literally cannot grow by borrowing. Verified empirically (kiri: limit 4343 before & after borrowing full available; mara: limit $4,031 unchanged after $50 borrow then repay).

credit_profile properly clamps available=max(0, limit-debt) so loan-eligibility uses a single source of truth (credit_available), eliminating the old 'limit displayed vs limit actually borrowable' confusion.
Blocked path (L321-323, L329-330): when legal_reputation<25, blocked=True AND limit is clamped to current debt — so player can still repay but cannot draw more. Correct semantics.
POST /api/bank/loan recomputes credit_profile AFTER the loan (L748) and returns the new credit_limit + credit_available — frontend can sync without a second GET.
POST /api/bank/repay resets credit_missed=0 only when debt reaches 0 (L766-768) — sensible 'clean slate' restoration; partial repay does not reset, which is correct.

game_engine.py L414 sets credit_missed_flag when accrue_recurring pushes a player into negative debt territory; _flush_daily_summary L117-121 increments (cap 10) on flagged days, decrements on clean days. Light verification confirms credit_missed value flows through credit_profile and shows up in reasons. (Cap and decrement-on-clean-day are good — prevents permanent black mark.)

estimate_income_per_day (L266-279): uses hourly_wage × 6 productive hours/day + sum of profitable businesses' last_net_day. Reasonable, but note it does NOT include player_employment wages (player working FOR someone else's business) — minor underestimate for player-employees; not a blocker since job hourly_wage path covers the formal-job case which is the primary credit-bearing income.
POST /api/bank/loan blocked-check (L735) runs BEFORE the amount<=available check, so a blocked player attempting any loan correctly gets 403 not 400. Order matters here — verified.
Frontend Bank.jsx correctly disables loan-button on (info.blocked || loanAmt<=0 || overLimit) and displays loan-over-limit text — UX clearly signals why borrowing is unavailable.
(non-credit nit, carried over) server.py still ~2100 lines; bank endpoints could move to a router module before more features land, but not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Credit system (P0 anti-stacking economy fix) is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_credit_system.py. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_credit_system.py -v -o addopts= (the project's pytest.ini sets xdist 'loadscope' addopts; override or pass -o addopts= to avoid duplicate plugin args). The CORE invariant being protected: credit_limit must NOT change when a player borrows (because limit is derived from net_worth = cash+bank-debt+assets, and a loan adds equally to bank and debt). If a future change accidentally couples credit_limit to bank+cash again, the test test_borrow_full_available_then_second_loan_rejected will catch it immediately. P1 queued items (transaction log, confirm dialogs, realism fixes) are NOT in scope and were not tested this run. config.time_scale was not modified (still 1.0).
rca of the issue: Original P0 bug (now fixed) — loan limit formula max(500, (bank+cash)*3 + finance*500) made borrowing INCREASE the limit because each successful loan adds to bank. Player could loop: borrow → new limit > debt → borrow more → ... unbounded money. Fix: credit_profile() now derives the limit from net_worth (cash+bank-debt+assets) which is INVARIANT under a loan, plus skill/income/reputation factors that don't change between consecutive loans. Verified: borrowing full credit_available leaves credit_limit identical and credit_available ~= 0; a second loan request returns 400 with explicit 'You can borrow up to $0 more (total limit $X, already used $X)'. Anti-stacking property holds. Additionally verified deposit/withdraw don't change credit_limit (closes the old exploit surface where moving cash to bank inflated borrowing power).
